cards.answer: Ho guardato un film a casa.
cards.notes: What did you do last night? / I watched a film at home.
Have you eaten? / Yes, I've already had lunch.

cards.answer: Non molto, ho sentito dei rumori.
cards.notes: Did you sleep well? / Not really, I heard some noises.

cards.answer: Sì, le ho viste sul tavolo.
cards.notes: Have you seen my keys? / Yes, I saw them on the table. With lo/la/li/le before avere, the participle agrees: le ho viste.
How was your day? / Good, but I worked a lot.

cards.answer: Non ancora, ne ho letto metà.
cards.notes: Have you finished the book? / Not yet, I've read half of it.
Did you book the restaurant? / Yes, I called this morning.

cards.answer: Del pane e un po' di frutta.
cards.notes: What did you buy? / Some bread and a bit of fruit.
Did you hear the news? / No, what happened?
Have you already seen this film? / Yes, I saw it last year.

cards.answer: Scusa, non ho sentito il telefono.
cards.notes: Why didn't you answer? / Sorry, I didn't hear the phone.
Did you have a nice weekend? / Yes, we went walking in the mountains.
